# Cua Driver

The patches in `../patches/cua-driver-0.28.2/` modify Cua Driver from
[trycua/cua](https://github.com/trycua/cua), pinned to commit
`fc188250b4ca8549b8e61f937fdb1fb560770e86`.

[CUA_LICENSE.md](CUA_LICENSE.md) preserves the upstream MIT notice, including
copyright (c) 2025 Cua AI, Inc. The notice applies to upstream-derived code;
it does not assign a license to all original code in this repository.

Native source checkouts and compiled app bundles are generated locally under
`mac/artifacts/` and are not committed. Python dependency licenses remain with
their respective distributions.
